paite: Huai khit in, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Kuan inla, hiai a kipan paitou in, nang leh Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiak mite, na suante kiang ah ka hon pe ding, chi a, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a ka kichiamna gam ah.
heading: TOUPA'N Sinai Tang Nuse Ding In Israelte Thu Apia

paite: Na ma ah ka angel ka sawl ding a; huchi in Kanaante, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste ka hawlkhe ding.
Bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam ah hohtou un. Migenhakte na hih ziak un, kei na lak ua hohtou lou ding ka hi. Huchi lou in zaw lampi ah ka hon kangtum kha ding," achi hi.
Mite'n hiai thuhoih lou azak un, alungkham uhi. Huchi in mi kuamah kizepna a kizem a-om kei uh.

TOUPA'N lah Mosi kiang ah, "Israel suante kiang ah, migenhakte na hi uhi. Mitphiat kal lou a na lak ua hong tou a, hong kangtum thei ka hi. Huaiziak in na tung ua bang hih ding ka hia, chih ka theihna ding in na kizepnate uh suahkhia un," chi in ana gen khinta hi.
Huchi in Israel suante'n Horeb tang ah akizepnate uh asuahkhe vek uhi.

Mosi in puanin asut a, giahphual polam, giahphual a pan gamlapi ah akai a, Kihoupihna Biakbuk, achi hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, michih TOUPA zongte kihoupihna biakbuk, giahphual polam a om ah ahoh uhi.
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, puanin lam a Mosi apaikhiak teng in, mite avek un adingh ua, michih apuanin kongkhak bul ah adingh ua; puanin a alut mateng Mosi a-enzui uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, puanin a Mosi alutleh, meipi khuam ahong kumsuk a, puanin kongkhak bul ah adingh a, huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupihta hi.
Mi tengteng in puanin kongkhak bul a dingh, meipi khuam amu uhi. Mi tengteng adingh ua abia uhi; michih in apuanin kongkhak chiat ah.
Mi'n alawm ahoupih bang in, TOUPA'N kimaituah in Mosi ahoupih hi. Huchi in giahphual ah akik nawn a, himahleh asikha Joshua, Nun tapa, tangval nou ahihleh puanin a pan apaikhe kei hi.

Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "En in, hiai mite hon pitou in na hon chi a, himahleh ka kiang a kua hon sawl ding na hia chih na hon theisak kei hi. Hinapi in lah, na min in ka hon thei a, ka mitmuh in hehpihna leng na mu hi, na chi hi.
heading: TOUPA'N Amite Ompih Achiam

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ka hon ngen ahi. Na mitmuh a hehpihna ka muhleh, nang ka hon theihna ding leh na mitmuh a hehpihna ka muhtheihna ding in, tu in na lampi hon ensak in. Hiai nam na mite ahi, chih ngaihtuah in," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka ompihna nang toh aton dia, khawlna ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Na ompihna kei toh aton kei dingleh, hiai a pan hon pitou ke'n.

N'on tonpih keileh, bangchi in na mite leh ke'n na mitmuh in deihsakna ka mu uh chih kithei ding ahia? Leitung pumpi a teng mi tengteng a pan kei leh na mite atuam ka hi uh, chih bang in akichiansak dia?" achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ka mitmuh in deihsakna na mu a, na min in ka hon theita a, hiai na nget pen leng ka hon hihsak ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka hon ngen hi, na thupina hon ensak in," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Na ma ah ka hoihna tengteng ka paisak dia, na ma ah TOUPA min ka tangkoupih ding. 'Ka hehpih nopmi, ka hehpih dia, zahngaihna ka lah nopmi kiang ah zahngaihna ka lak ding,' achi hi.
Himahleh ka mai na mu thei kei ding; mi, kei hon mu, ahing kuamah a-om louh ziak in.
TOUPA'N, 'En in, hiai ah ka kiang ah mun khat a-om a; suangpi tung ah na dingh in.
Huchi in hichi ahi ding a, ka thupina in hon khen sung in suangpi heng ah ka hon koih dia, ka hon khen sung in ka khut in ka hon khuh ding hi.
Huai khit chiang in ka khut ka lakhe dia, huchi in ka nunglam na mu dia; himahleh ka mai bel akimu kei ding, " achi hi.
